pyrefly.bash: if [ -x .venv/bin/pyrefly ]; then exec .venv/bin/pyrefly lsp; elif command -v pyrefly >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pyrefly lsp; elif command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec uvx pyrefly lsp; else exec pipx run pyrefly lsp; fi
pyrefly.powershell: if (Test-Path .venv\Scripts\pyrefly.exe) { .venv\Scripts\pyrefly.exe lsp } elseif (Get-Command pyrefly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pyrefly lsp } elseif (Get-Command uvx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { uvx pyrefly lsp } else { pipx run pyrefly lsp }
